subject: The one file every Arts Award level reads for who and where. Changing a slot is a one-file edit, never a deck rewrite.

rules.noDeckAssertsAVisit: No deck states a visit is happening.
rules.preparationOnly: Desk research, archives and video are PREPARATION only, and every deck labels them so.
rules.noDatesInDecks: No dated event, exhibition or season appears inside any deck. Dates live here.
rules.routeAgnostic: Every deck serving a slot-dependent part is authored route-agnostic across R1, R2 and R3.
rules.noneBooked: Every candidate below is UNCONFIRMED. Nothing here is asserted as booked.

EVENT_SLOT.what: an arts event or experience attended as an AUDIENCE MEMBER

ORG_SLOT.what: an arts organisation, reached through live or active experience

PRACTITIONER_SLOT.what: an artist or practitioner MET first-hand

SHOWING_SLOT.note: A workshop for another class is leadership, not a public showing.
